name: RepoProbe-Python
status_note: Stage 1 (16 task_ids) ran cleanly across all 5 methods with no infrastructure/fairness defect (the single agent-framework-8/ant HTTP-500 was a transient provider failure, not a defect, and was recovered separately -- see the frozen transient-provider retry policy). Per the pre-registered rule, Stage 2 extension (16 more task_ids, same seeded draw) is now ACTIVATED unconditionally -- this activation was decided before Stage 1's scores were used for anything, and does not depend on what those scores were. Combined Stage 1 + Stage 2 = 32 fixed RepoProbe-Python tasks, 4/repo across the same 8 repositories. Programmatic activation validation: output/runs/repoprobe-python-stage2-activation-validation.json.
inclusion_criterion: repository primary_language == 'Python' per RepoProbe's own repos_info.json metadata (benchmark-provided language label, not a derived/heuristic classification)
sampling_method: ant.evaluation_suite.sampling.stratified_sample, per_stratum=4, stratum_key=repo_short_name -- one deterministic draw of 4 task_ids per repo; first 2 (in the draw's own order) become stage_1, remaining 2 become stage_2_extension. Never resampled independently.
